title: Scanner and Faction Ops
subtitle: Signals become choices
summary: Lens scans, HoloMap markers, faction standing, drone warnings, and cache rewards should describe the same route state in different views.
body: Scan first, then follow the marker. A good scan names risk, linked mission, route status, and a readable follow-up.
Faction contacts are not free combat objectives. Crashbreak and Radwarden hooks should start as recognition, standing, and optional contract work.
Cache rewards need a readable reason: survival buffer, route prep, repair part, faction proof, or late-game intel.
